{{Quote|Doc! How's Jessop? He okay?"<br /> "Your friend suffered from a rakghoul bite."<br />"Just a bite. So he got off easy?"<br /> "He was infected with the rakghoul plague. He was turning into one of them, so I spared him the misery.|A Republic soldier and a doctor discuss Jessop|<ref name="SWTOR" />}}
'''Jessop''' was an individual who was friends with a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Unidentified Republic soldier (Taris)|Republic soldier]].<ref name="SWTOR" /> At some point by [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Jessop was bitten by a [[rakghoul]],<ref name="SWTOR" /> a type of [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawn]],<ref name="KotOR25">[[Knights of the Old Republic 25|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 25]]</ref> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. As a result, Jessop was contaminated with the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|rakghoul plague]], which transformed the infected themselves into rakghouls. A [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Unidentified Twi'lek doctor (Taris)|doctor]] attempted to save Jessop but eventually opted to spare him from becoming a rakghoul and [[Death/Legends|killed]] him instead. The [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] later informed the [[Republic soldier]] of Jessop's death.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jessop was first introduced in the [[2011]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]]. He is mentioned during a conversation between two non-player characters on the planet Taris.<ref name="SWTOR" />
